gpu_tip: ~39GB total at 128K context. An i-quant: imatrix-calibrated, and here slightly larger but higher quality than Q3_K_L, at the cost of more CPU work per token for any layer that spills. An 8GB GPU (e.g. RTX 4060) plus a 48GB DDR5 kit covers it; I-quants run best on CUDA/ROCm.
mac_tip: Needs ~39GB — fits a 48GB MacBook Pro comfortably.
